prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Tyler TX?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV tanning beds/booths or spray (airbrush/mist) tanning? I can look up current top-rated salons in Tyler, TX and give addresses, hours and recent reviews — which would take a moment.

If you want a quick recommendation approach instead of me searching, here’s what I suggest and why:

- If safety and natural-looking results are most important: choose a reputable spray-tan salon with certified techs (better color, no UV exposure).
- If you want indoor UV tanning: pick a salon with modern beds (not old, high-pressure beds), good ventilation, and clear staff guidance on session length by skin type.
- Check recent Google and Yelp reviews for cleanliness, consistency, and customer photos.
- Ask about technician certification, product brands (for spray tans, Norvell/Jan Marini/etc.), patch tests, and aftercare.
- Compare membership/package pricing if you plan to tan regularly.

Want me to find the current top-rated tanning salons in Tyler, TX now and list 3–5 with addresses, hours and latest review highlights? If so, tell me whether you prefer spray or UV tanning.
